why: Jack 25 Oct: new Flow project, many host designs, avoid AI slop
prompt: Photograph a presenter on a tiny local-access television set, taken on a Ricoh GR compact from slightly above, framed a little off-centre and not quite level. He sits behind a chipped melamine desk with a mug of tea and a tangle of cables blurred in the near foreground, mid-way through shuffling a stack of papers. His whole head is in a hand-knitted cream wool balaclava, slightly pilled, with no eye or mouth holes; a thin black ring is embroidered around the face in slightly uneven stitches, and high inside the ring, over one eye, a small red felt triangle with rounded corners is sewn on. A black roll-neck, a worn grey suit a size too big, black knitted gloves. Behind him a boxy old television on a trolley shows a muddy picture of a city skyline. One overhead fluorescent tube lights the room flat and slightly green. Kodak Gold 200, visible grain. Thanks.
